definitions.openings: Quarter-resolution background sample with a building sample above in the same column and on each side in the same row. Gaps may open onto the floor. This image-space proxy can include space between separate structures.
definitions.filled: Covered by the union of predicted outline polygons; each opening pixel counts once per frame.
definitions.joined: Distinct matched truth patches whose planes differ in optical-axis depth by at most 0.5 blocks at both endpoint rays. Each ray uses the midpoint of the two proposed corner pixels. This tests depth consistency on extended planes; physical contact also requires their visible extents to meet.
